mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause ototoxicity; concurrent use increases risk of aminoglycoside-induced renal and eighth cranial nerve damage, particularly in patients with renal impairment or malaria-related complications.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN), auditory function, and vestibular symptoms closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antimalarial agents if possible; if combination is necessary, use lowest effective amikacin dose with extended dosing intervals.
